own_solution.law: Static friction supplies centripetal force on a flat curve: m v^2 / r <= mu_s m g, so v_max = sqrt(mu_s g r)
assumptions: car treated as a point mass moving on a circle of the stated radius
uniform circular motion, no tangential acceleration

defect_reasons.other: TF5BA uses past tense ('On this run, the car kept to a lane') while the question is in the present, a minor wording mismatch that does not change the reading.

notes: v_max = sqrt(0.6*9.8*50) = sqrt(294) = 17.146 m/s. With r = 57.5 m: sqrt(338.1) = 18.388 m/s. Mass cancels (TFE1E, T79A4, both 1350 kg). 7.5 m sentences (T02CA, T82EB, T9AEC, TF5BA) consistent in number and unit; 'a little further' sentences (T7092, T5A6E) are non-numeric D sentences.
